claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic QUBO projection adapter for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes one exact F2-WP-400 WorldSlice plus explicit caller-supplied binary decision variables and integer linear/quadratic biases and emits only an immutable, canonical, solver-neutral QUBO projection bound to the exact WorldSlice digest. Variables may reference only atoms already selected in the slice; couplings may reference only declared variables; duplicate variables/couplings, mutable containers, malformed coefficients and source-slice mismatches fail closed. The adapter does not invent objectives, infer truth, run a solver, accept a solver result as world fact, read/write UnifiedDB, invoke models/providers/tools, authorize effects, mint completion, or claim runtime/physical-GRID10/GWT/J-Space/whole-system credit. Source plus deterministic fail-closed tests and repository-hosted CI only.
dependencies: F2-WP-400 generation 1 accepted sparse world basis at repository-hosted component-CI scope
F2-WP-401 generation 1 accepted world-maintenance proposals at repository-hosted component-CI scope
